steps.name: it is the emulator, not a stray device
tap an app icon by its label
steps.comment: By label, not coordinates: uiautomator knows where it is, so this survives a change of device or resolution.

steps.name: the tap really launched it
steps.comment: Read the resumed activity off the device rather than trusting the screenshot.

steps.name: tap the search box by its label
steps.comment: The label is a plain text node; the tap lands on the control wrapping it.

steps.name: the search screen really opened
steps.comment: Confirm before typing, so a failure says which half broke.

steps.name: the typing really reached the field
steps.comment: Asserted immediately: the Google search module is unstable on an emulator without Play services and can drop back to the Settings home a second or two later.

steps.name: and the field holds the query
